about: The routing block a product's forge integration carries (PATCH /api/teams/{id}/forge/repo-bots/{integration_id}, `routing`) so that every LLM site of the shipped Revi pair runs on claw against the team's own PLIAGE gateway model, with the reasoning effort of each node decided by its cell (#3283, D2).

The cells without `effort` are the activation block of 2026-11-10, as 17 integrations carried it on 2026-11-15 (read-only GET, the same block on all 17). Each `effort` is a level the platform's `pliage` feed accepts for the cell's model (testdata/pliage_declared_entries.json), so the route sends it as asked and emits no reasoning_effort_adjusted (ADR-166 section 7 keeps ties going up, D3).
`effort` sits on node cells only: a `#glm` route runs at its node's effort and a supervisor names a model only, so llmroute.Validate refuses the field on both.
scripts/ops/revi-effort-cells.py applies the `effort` fields of this block, and nothing else, to each integration's stored block.

effort_rationale.revi-converse/converse_agent: high (D4). The node's own dial asks `medium`, which the feed does not list, so every converse step already ran at `high` (reasoning_effort_adjusted, source feed:pliage). The cell names the level the run gets.
effort_rationale.review-pr/reviewer_claude: high (plan section 2). A full-tier reviewer keeps high. Its dial reads `max` on the platform (bot-vars ITERION_VIBE_EFFORT_CLAUDE, set 2026-11-04): on 2026-11-13 reviewer_claude sent `max`, 86-92% of its output thinking. The cell fixes high whatever the dial reads.
effort_rationale.review-pr/reviewer_claude_glance: low (plan section 2, chosen explicitly). F15: `low` is the lowest level the feed lists for deepseek-v4.1-flash, so effortAfterCut (pkg/backend/model/structured_recovery.go) has nothing to lower to: a final turn cut at max_tokens, or a recovery pass that failed, gets no retry at a reduced effort on this node. Accepted for the cheap tier; M2a counts the cut final passes and the node goes back to high if they appear.
effort_rationale.review-pr/reviewer_gpt_glance: low (plan section 2, chosen explicitly), with reviewer_claude_glance's F15 consequence: no reduced-effort retry is left below low.
effort_rationale.review-pr/converge: low (plan section 2, chosen explicitly). The merge step reads two structured outputs; F15 as for the glances: below low there is no reduced-effort retry. M2a counts the cut final passes; back to high if they appear.
effort_rationale.review-pr/converge_gpt: low (plan section 2, chosen explicitly), the merge twin of converge, with the same F15 consequence.
